title: Understanding the Art of Teaching Yoga
author: Made Agus
paragraphs: After spending a long time in the world of yoga, from trying challenging hatha yoga poses, practicing fast-paced flows, and exploring the gentle practice of yin yoga. I can honestly say that all of it has been a joy and has brought many benefits. But what truly makes our yoga journey feel like it’s evolving? This question can only be answered by someone who has been immersed in the practice for a long time. A person who understands how the body and mind naturally select poses according to their age. Specifically, the composition of these poses can change based on the body’s and mind’s needs in a natural way. We shouldn’t glorify one style of yoga too much, nor should we be attached to our ego or fanaticism. Let’s practice yoga according to what our body and mind truly need.

If we want to invite younger individuals, say ages 15-35, to join a full yin class, most of them may not be interested because their bodies and minds don’t yet need that. Naturally, their bodies are still fit, and their minds are dynamic. Similarly, if we try to get people aged 45-65 to practice challenging poses with fast flows, not only will it be difficult, but it could also be dangerous for them.

As teachers, we must understand the cycles of yoga. We need to know different styles so that when we teach, we are rich in knowledge. A good yoga teacher is someone who can teach precisely and prioritize the safety of their students. A good teacher is one who possesses adequate knowledge to provide understanding to their students. So the benefits of yoga be fully experienced.
Happy practicing, and happy teaching...

title: Teaching Practice.
author: Made Agus
paragraphs: After going through several dramas yesterday which were quite "funny", today we gather again. This morning was quite bright and I notice one by one TTC participants' face. Seems like they are quite ready to do teaching practice.

As usual, the last day of each module will be filled with teaching practice. Not to determine the graduation, but to inspire enthusiasm for teaching and sharing. And the most important is the feedback by lead teacher Yuni.

We often are not aware of our own strengths and weaknesses. It seems like we always need someone who is able to see that and convey it objectively so that in the future we can be better and sharper in teaching.
You need to believe that criticism given with love and affection will be able to bring out goodness and improve talents that may have been hidden.
Enjoy your practice! Believe me, one day you will definitely miss this moment of togetherness.
Na'ma'ska'r.

title: Yin Yoga, An Ancient Tradition of Transformations
author: Made Agus
paragraphs: At the beginning of the development Yin yoga, many people were enthusiastic about learning. However, some people consider this style is a bit "foreign" because it doesn't look like the yoga they are familiar with. As time goes by, more and more of the yoga practitioners finally realize that Yin yoga has its own place. Like finding a "hidden treasure", many yoga lovers find out what yin yoga is.

Yin Yoga becomes more and more well known nowadays. Not because the pose looks cool, but because the benefits are real. With simple movements that adjust to different human body types, it turns out very useful for improving the circulation of prana or chi inside our body.

Indeed, "Yin Yoga" is new, but the spirit that creates this style has been developing for thousand years. Yin Yang is a philosophy of life that prioritizes balance. This is the well-known basic principle, and when we applied in the modern era it will become unique and special.
The question is, is it necessary to adopt ancient traditions and concoct them into modern version?

The answer is: absolutely! Yin Yoga is very related to Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). This scientifically developed for a very long time and still exist today. Time has proven that “natural medicine” is a safe treatment and is still in demand.

It could be said that Yin Yoga is a yoga style that applies ancient traditions to be brought back today. Its unique approach is able to restore energy balance in the body and creating harmony in our body.
Today is the last day for participants Module 2, “Unwind & Letting Go.”
Hopefully, the short and dense study period can be absorbed very well. Happy sharing, Na'ma'ska'r.

title: Anatomy: Our Body is Created Unique and Different from Each Other. Love it.
author: Made Agus
paragraphs: Every human being is created uniquely. In many ways we are different from each other, and sometimes we easily equate them. Likewise, in the world of yoga, the human body is the foundation for yoga movements, especially yoga asanas. To achieve optimal health, we have to understand how our body works.

The uniqueness of this body means that many movements can’t be the same for everyone. Modifying yoga poses is very important to reduce the risk of injury m, so we can bring our practice to its true goal: physical and spiritual health.

Unfortunately, many yoga practitioners and even yoga teachers don't really understand anatomy. They only learn a little so they are unable to apply in the yoga classes they teach. This is not right, and many injuries occur due to a yoga teacher forcing their students to do a certain pose. They just think “If i can do this pose, and my students should be able to do it too!”
That's why I say that yoga poses can be dangerous if we do without a strong basic understanding of the body anatomy.

Today we learn anatomy at teacher training Yin Yoga. Our lead teacher Yuni explains anatomy clearly in simple language. It is hoped that all participants from various practice levels can understand and absorb the knowledge very well.

title: Raise Your Energy. Say hi to the beautiful world.
author: Made Agus
paragraphs: A shiny morning! It seems like yesterday it was raining around the yoga studio. The air feels clean. Even though I was a little worried because I was quite tired on the first day, plus working until 12 at night, turned out that I was in a pretty good mood this morning.
Body condition is quite fit. Is this because the body is entering "survive" mode? hahaha maybe.

Yoga experts often comment on the effectiveness of "the power of the mind." Maybe it works naturally the way it works for me, and for many other people too. Sometimes we don't realize it. I believe that there’s a very close connection between the mind and the body. When we strengthen our minds, our bodies will adjust and ready to work harder. Likewise what happens, vice versa.

So what is the basis for us to be able to strengthen our minds? The answer is when we are aware of the responsibilities charged on us. And try to present the best that we can. Showing enthusiasm to everyone we meet will influence the flow of energy around you.
Today we learn more about in yoga, Asana Lab.
Have a nice day today, Na'ma'ska'r

title: A Stunning Small Step
author: Made Agus
paragraphs: When we plan something good, we often get lost in the idealism that the whole process will be beautiful, smooth and without obstacles.
But sometimes we forget one thing: a struggle. Almost all success stories start from struggle and work hard. Dare to be successfull means dare to stumble and even sometimes fall.

That's it! Today we start the struggle. Sleepy, tired, Bali's hot weather… we got through everything perfectly. Even though it's hard, we should give ourselves appreciation and applause because one day has passed. We did it!

For sure there're still the next following days require a powerful spirit to pass. As long as you whisper "I'm beyond grateful for this opportunity that made for me", there always be an open door to your success.
Thank you for our togetherness today. We hope the relationship of love that we present always brings new enthusiasm to accompany your little step of life journey. Na'ma'skar.
Swastam Yoga Bali, January 15, 2024

title: New World, New Friends
author: Made Agus
paragraphs: For those who already know us, they understand the connection between teacher and our students is not tense and formal. We always be your family. Full of jokes when meet, but serious in class. We want the students to feel relax during the learning process, so the knowledge can be well received.

No drama in class. So, be who you are and never underestimate yourself. You are capable of more than you can ever imagine. With a tight study duration, it doesn't even cross into our minds to cause unnecessary problems.
Anything that can make the teaching process also the learning process easier, we take it, we put forth on it. Don't waste your time and energy. Don't let your efforts be in vain.
As our lead teacher Yuni said, "In class there is no graduation test, only teaching practice. The real test is when you teach a real class.”

Once again, hopefully in the next 4 weeks we will be given health, enthusiasm, determination to study and discipline. Because this is our asset for sharing yoga. Be the best version of yourself. The universe is full of blessings, Na'ma'skar.
Swastam Yoga Bali, January 14, 2024
